text.tspan: Check upgrade phase: PRECHECK DOWNLOAD STAGING UPGRADE
vmkernel.log grep LSOM DOM on ESXi
vmkernel.log grep APD PDL NMP on ESXi
Verify VxRail Manager can reach vCenter: ping
Check VxRail Manager service: systemctl status mystic
Check failing check name in lcm.log
Resolve pre-check issue and retry LCM
Verify iDRAC and ESXi host reachability
esxcli vsan debug object list on ESXi
Check which node hosts the absent component
esxcli storage core path list for APD paths
Check vmnic link status: esxcli network nic list
racadm getsel tail 50 for SEL history
racadm storage get pdisks for disk health
Check management vmk0 IP and gateway
VxRail plugin: Support > Generate Support Bundle
